THE BAILLIE GIFFORD JAPAN TRUST PLC (BGFD)

The Baillie Gifford Japan Trust PLC (‘the Company’) hereby gives notification that Sharon Brown, a Director of the Company, has been appointed a non-executive director of Murray International Trust PLC with effect from 1 December 2026.
